Render a table as a plain pipe table

Source: R/tab_md.R
tab_pipe.Rd

The markdown grid without the markup: one GFM pipe table, its unit line kept (<col%>, <var>), no colour spans, no footer and no stylesheet. It is what the console prints under a table for each of its subordinate tables (set_footer_tabs), the same shape a regression's shape table takes there — a grid one can read as text and paste anywhere.

It is tab_md with three arguments fixed, not a second renderer: a pipe table that drifted from the markdown export would be a second answer to one question.

Usage

tab_pipe(tabs, ...)

Arguments

tabs

A tabxplor_tab, or a list of them.

...

Passed to tab_md — color = TRUE brings the colour spans back, subtext = TRUE the footer.

Value

A character vector, one element per line.

See also

tab_md(), set_footer_tabs().

Examples

cat(tab_pipe(tab(forcats::gss_cat, race, marital, pct = "row")), sep = "\n")
#> | race    |No answer  |Never married  |Separated  |Divorced  |Widowed  |Married  |          Total  |
#> |:--------|----------:|--------------:|----------:|---------:|--------:|--------:|----------------:|
#> |         | *marital* |               |           |          |         |         |                 |
#> |         | *<row%>*  |               |           |          |         |         |   *<row% (n)>*  |
#> | Other   |       0%  |          32%  |       6%  |     11%  |     4%  |    48%  |  100% ( 1 959)  |
#> | Black   |       0%  |          42%  |       6%  |     16%  |     8%  |    28%  |  100% ( 3 129)  |
#> | White   |       0%  |          21%  |       3%  |     16%  |     9%  |    51%  |  100% (16 395)  |
#> |**Total**|     **0%**|        **25%**|     **3%**|   **16%**|   **8%**|  **47%**|**100%** (21 483)|
